text: dsh-schedule-send 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的定时发送插件。在会话输入框旁加入时钟控件，用户可选择快捷时间或本地日期时间，将纯文本草稿安排到当前会话稍后发送。Host 将任务持久化到本地队列，并在到期后把内容作为普通用户消息提交到原会话；会话中的状态卡片可取消尚未发送的任务。适合希望预先安排提示或消息、让 DSH 会话稍后继续处理的用户。应用需在发送时运行；无需额外账号或 API Key。

dsh-schedule-send lets DSH Web users schedule plain-text messages from the composer clock control. Choose a preset or custom time, then cancel queued sends from the conversation card. The Host stores tasks locally and submits due messages as ordinary user messages. DSH must be running at send time.
想把写好的消息定个时间，让它稍后发进当前 DSH 会话。
DSH 能不能在指定时间自动把一段文字作为我的消息提交？
我想用快捷选项安排半小时、一小时或几小时后发送草稿。
有没有办法取消还在队列里的定时消息？
关掉应用后错过时间的消息，能否下次启动时补发？
想给当前会话设置一个具体的本地日期和时间再发送纯文本。
Can I queue a plain text message to arrive in this conversation at a chosen time?
How can I cancel a message that has not been sent yet?
I want to set up a message now so the same DSH chat continues later.
dsh-schedule-send 的功能「安排会话消息」：把当前纯文本草稿加入指定发送时间，并送入当前会话。用户通过输入框旁的时钟控件选择快捷时间或自定义时间。
dsh-schedule-send 的功能「查看和取消任务」：会话消息卡片显示排队状态，并允许取消仍处于待发送状态的任务。用户在卡片上点击取消；已开始投递或已离队的任务不能撤回。
dsh-schedule-send 的功能「到期投递」：Host 定期检查本地队列，将到期内容作为普通用户消息提交到原会话。到期任务在应用下次启动后也会重新检查；失败时会重试。
dsh-schedule-send 将排队消息保存在本地 $DSH_HOME/schedule-send/queue.json；未设置 DSH_HOME 时使用 ~/.dsh。到期投递依赖应用运行，关闭期间到期的任务会在下次启动后处理。
定时发送只接受纯文本草稿；如果当前草稿含附件，浏览器端会禁用安排发送控件，因此需要先移除附件再安排消息。

dsh-schedule-send README · dsh-schedule-send：Schedule-send for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): write a message in the composer, pick a time, and the text is delivered into the **same conversation** later as a **normal user message** — exactly as if you had pressed Send at that moment, so the agent answers it and the thread continues.

dsh-schedule-send README · Features：- A clock control in the composer tool row, beside the send button.
- Quick picks (30 minutes, 1 hour, 3 hours, tomorrow 09:00) or an exact local date and time.
- The draft is cleared immediately; a persistent card in the conversation records what is queued, when it sends, and offers **Cancel**.
- Durable queue outside the workspace, with catch-up: a send that came due while the app was closed is delivered on the next start.
- The delivered text is a real user message (`source.kind = 'user'`), not a reminder or a system notice.
- Retries with exponential backoff; the send id doubles as the prompt `requestId`, so a retry after a crash cannot deliver twice.
- No build step and no runtime dependencies beyond the page's shared `react` / `react-dom`.

dsh-schedule-send README · Why not the built-in reminders?：DSH's built-in Schedule subsystem is a reminder system: it injects a `[SCHEDULE REMINDER]` framing that tells the model to **present** the text to the user instead of treating it as an instruction. A scheduled send needs the opposite semantics — the text must become the user's message and start a turn. This plugin therefore keeps its own durable queue and delivers through the public `ctx.sessionController.prompt(...)` seam, which resumes a cold session when needed and mints an ordinary user message.

dsh-schedule-send README · Install：The package declares both a Host half (`index.js`, which owns the queue, the commands, and delivery) and a browser half (`client.js`). There is no build script, so every route installs finished files.

dsh-schedule-send README · Option 1: the release tarball (recommended)：Download `dsh-schedule-send-0.1.0.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/Zhiyi-Zhao/dsh-schedule-send/releases), then:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-schedule-send-0.1.0.tgz
```

dsh-schedule-send README · Option 2: straight from GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Zhiyi-Zhao/dsh-schedule-send
```

A `dsh web` profile uses the same spec with `--profile web`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Zhiyi-Zhao/dsh-schedule-send
```

dsh-schedule-send README · Option 3: from a local checkout：```sh
git clone https://github.com/Zhiyi-Zhao/dsh-schedule-send.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-schedule-send
```

dsh-schedule-send README · Option 4: the Web UI：Open the sidebar's **Plugins** page, choose to install a bundle, and paste one of the specs above (`github:Zhiyi-Zhao/dsh-schedule-send`, a tarball URL, or an absolute path). Installing from the running app needs `danger-full-access` permission or an approval.

> `--profile desktop` names the desktop app's profile. A `dsh web` deployment uses `--profile web`; the bundle works in any profile that composes the Web client. Replace `desktop` with your profile name in every command below.

dsh-schedule-send README · Option 4: the Web UI：After installing into the desktop profile, the new bundle can apply through HMR; if it does not appear, restart DeepSeek Harness. Uninstall with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-schedule-send
```

dsh-schedule-send README · Usage：1. Type the message in any conversation (plain text).
2. Click the clock button to the left of Send.
3. Pick a quick time, or set an exact local date and time.
4. Confirm with **Schedule**. The draft is cleared and a "Scheduled send" card appears in the conversation.
5. At the chosen time the message is delivered into that conversation as a normal user message; the agent answers it. **Cancel** on the card works until delivery.

dsh-schedule-send README · Usage：The card stays in the transcript as history. After delivery, Cancel reports that the message already left the queue.

> The package also registers two internal session commands (`schedule-send`, `schedule-send-cancel`) because the session command channel is how a browser plugin reaches its Host half. They appear in the slash menu; you never need to type them — the clock control is the interface.

dsh-schedule-send README · How it works：| Step | Where | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| Create | Browser | The composer control calls `ctx.remote.commands.execute('/schedule-send <json>')` with the message, the target epoch, an id, and the browser's IANA zone. |
| Persist | Host | The command handler validates the payload and writes a record to `$DSH_HOME/schedule-send/queue.json` (atomic temp-file rename). |
| Sweep | Host | A 5-second sweep picks due records and calls `ctx.sessionController.prompt({ requestId: id, sessionId, mode: 'queue', content, clientTimeZone })`. |
| Deliver | Host | That public method resumes the session if needed and submits a normal user message; the send id is the dedupe key, so retries are idempotent. |
| Feedback | Browser | The command lifecycle renders as the persistent card through a `conversation.chat.commandview` renderer keyed by the command name. |

dsh-schedule-send README · Verified delivery：One real scheduled send, read back from the Host queue (local time, Europe/Copenhagen):

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| status | `delivered` |
| created | 2026-10-19 12:22:16 |
| target | 2026-10-19 12:24:00 |
| delivered | 2026-10-19 12:24:03 |
| delay | 3.2 s (inside the 5 s sweep interval) |

The delivered text appeared in the conversation as a normal user message and the agent answered it there.

dsh-schedule-send README · Limits：- **The app must be running when the send comes due.** DSH has no background scheduler; if the app is closed, the message is delivered shortly after the next start (catch-up). A closed app cannot send.
- **Text only.** A draft with attachments cannot be scheduled; the control is disabled.
- **Delivery resumes the target session and runs a turn**, even when that conversation is not open. It can spend tokens and call tools; approvals still follow that session's policy and may wait for you.
- **About ±5 seconds** of precision (the sweep interval).
- **One-shot only.** There is no recurring schedule and no edit-in-place; cancel and schedule again instead.
- A send that cannot be delivered (the session no longer exists, or the session has no routable model) is retried with backoff up to 60 attempts and then recorded as `failed` in the queue with `lastError`, with a warning in the Host log.
- A corrupt queue file is moved aside as `queue.json.corrupt-<timestamp>` and the plugin starts with an empty queue.

dsh-schedule-send README · Compatibility：- Host half: `ctx.commands.register`, `ctx.sessionController.prompt`, `ctx.sessions.flush`, `ctx.agents` — public services only.
- Browser half: the slot API (`conversation.input.right`, `conversation.chat.commandview`), the locale service, and `ctx.remote.commands.execute`; it imports only `react` and `react-dom`, not DSH UI primitives, so minor UI-package changes do not break it.
- If `ctx.sessionController` is absent, scheduled sends stay queued and a warning is logged instead of failing the profile.

client.js             Browser half: composer control, cards, locale dictionaries
cordis.patch.yml      Loader row inserted by the bundle
locale/{en,zh}.json   Display metadata read by the plugin inventory

dsh-schedule-send README · Development：- No build, no install step: the browser artifact is a plain closure factory.
- `npm run verify` checks the manifest, exports, locale metadata, both entry files, and the factory id.
- Install a working copy with `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-schedule-send`.
